title: Multi-Cell Merger & Rapid Electrification (2-Sigma Lightning Jump)
regime: Chota Nagpur Plateau / South Bihar Border (Merger Dynamics)
synoptic_narrative: Two discrete, rapidly intensifying convective storm cores (Cell Alpha and Cell Beta) converged over the Chota Nagpur plateau. The collision and merger of their updrafts triggered explosive vertical acceleration, producing a classic 2-sigma lightning jump: flash rates leaped from 4 flashes/min to 34 flashes/min within 10 minutes, generating dangerous cloud-to-ground strikes.
convective_features: Dual-cell convergence and updraft collision with sudden volume growth
Classical 2-sigma lightning jump detected across sequential 5-minute flash rate bins
Anticipatory lead time of 28 minutes prior to peak ground-strike casualties
Rigorous test of multi-cell tracking and object lifecycle continuity

imd_bulletin.bulletin_text: NOWCAST WARNING: Thunderstorm with lightning accompanied with gusty wind (30-40 kmph) likely to affect parts of Ranchi, Bokaro, and Hazaribagh districts during next 3 hours.
imd_bulletin.spatial_precision: District-wide advisory without cell merger anticipation.

baseline_expectations.climatology_persistence: Severely underestimates risk prior to merger; catches up only post-jump.
baseline_expectations.nwp_environmental_threshold: Predicts static background probability; completely misses the merger jump.
baseline_expectations.lagrangian_advection: Predicts cells to pass each other or superimpose linearly, ignoring nonlinear dynamical growth.
baseline_expectations.imd_text_bulletin: Issued general thunderstorm advisory without severe lightning warning.
baseline_expectations.vajra: Lightning jump detector fires at T+35m, raising probability to 0.88 with 28-min lead time.
